description: One-call safety gate for an LLM response: injection on the response, prompt and source, toxicity, PII, grounding (with source), guardrail rules, plus an LLM review on Groq (model "none": nothing leaves the server). PASS/REVIEW/FIX/BLOCK + 0-100 score: REVIEW when a claim the source does not back, or a check that failed (not_run), leaves it undecided. SSN/card → BLOCK, email → FIX, phone/IP flagged only.

model.description: LLM review model: openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b, qwen/qwen3.8-27b (default openai/gpt-oss-20b), or "none".

prompt.description: The original prompt — also scanned for injection; pass it whenever you have it.

source.description: Reference text for the grounding check.

name: shield_analyze
